domain storage word "disk" -> 0
domain storage word "memory" -> 1
domain storage: Use storage: disk or storage: memory
domain member state byte 1 -> joining
domain member state byte 2 -> active
domain member state byte 3 -> down
domain member state byte 4 -> leaving
domain member state byte 5 -> dead
domain member state byte: use 1 joining, 2 active, 3 down, 4 leaving or 5 dead
domain member state word: member state "\x00probe" is not a state: use joining, active, down, leaving or dead
domain setting keys: stale_reads, heartbeat_ms, step_down_ms, failover_ms, dead_ms, probe_interval_ms, probe_timeout_ms or probe_failures
domain role names: root reader writer db-manager user-manager cluster-manager backup-operator restore-operator
domain role root includes: root reader writer db-manager user-manager cluster-manager backup-operator restore-operator
domain role reader includes: reader
domain role writer includes: reader writer
domain role db-manager includes: reader writer db-manager
domain role user-manager includes: user-manager
domain role cluster-manager includes: cluster-manager
domain role backup-operator includes: reader backup-operator
domain role restore-operator includes: restore-operator

domain user request list: 256
domain user ceiling: 10000
domain reserved user name: __node__
domain credential algorithm: argon2id
